digest.component_or_area: Jira DC support hardening / capability detection and contract validation
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run (not pre-run) and reject reports that cannot be verified, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json
Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded at dispatch time and report capability-absent vs capability-raised distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than failing silently
The dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe.py modules) must be deleted entirely from the codebase
Runtime capability guards must use isinstance-primary detection with hasattr fallback to handle __getattr__-proxying transports on Python 3.12+
The live DC harness must not regress due to these changes; pre-existing failures from commit c87afedba8 are tracked separately on ticket 9590
